title: 33Miles
subtitle: Artist campaign and visual identity
description: A bold digital campaign system and social identity for 33Miles.

components.heading: 33Miles Campaign System
paragraphs: The 33Miles work develops a flexible visual system for an artist campaign across profile art, announcements, banners, and square social graphics.
Bold typography, high-contrast imagery, grain, and repeated graphic devices make individual posts feel connected without forcing every composition into the same template.
The resulting asset family can shift between portraits, information, and promotional moments while maintaining a recognizable campaign voice.

components.title: One identity, built across platform formats.
components.caption: The wide banner extends the campaign language into a horizontal composition.

components.title: The system stays recognizable while the composition changes.
components.caption: A square campaign execution designed for social feeds.
